lib.dateMissing: Date missing — complete the day, month and year.
lib.dateInvalid: Invalid date — check the day, month and 4-digit year.
lib.timeMissing: Time missing — complete the hour and minute.
lib.timeGap: This local time does not exist on this date (time zone or daylight saving change) — change the time.
lib.dateRangeYear: The date must be within {min}–{max} (write the year with 4 digits).

techniqueSelector.kpAyanamsaHint: The difference between KP-Newcomb and the old KP table is a few arc seconds today; it can change the sub-lord result only at points very close to a boundary.

chain.note: 1 extra request (none if cached). The record contains only the selected level's list and the 5 periods at this moment.

forecast.endBefore: The end cannot be before the start.
forecast.endMax: At most {max} days can be selected.
forecast.summary: {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} · {parts, plural, one {# part} other {# parts}} (provider limit 90 days/request; at most {max} days). Day details are calculated separately on the result screen if requested.

kpRange.noNodes: Rahu/Ketu are not available on these endpoints.
kpRange.posTooLong: The position table can be at most {max} days; shorten the duration or remove the position table.
kpRange.estimate: Estimated {n} provider requests (1 per planet × type; position table 1). Saved parts are not requested again; the exact count is in the plan preview. At most {max} days; the Moon changes Sub-Lord ~9 times a day.

transit.noteNow: Now: the calculation moment is rounded to the full UTC hour (e.g. 14:37 → 14:00 UTC); reopening within the same hour makes no new request. For minute precision use “Selected day and time”. The time zone is for display only.
transit.noteDate: Selected day: local 12:00 of that day is used (the Moon moves ~13° a day; choose a time for a specific moment).
transit.noteCustom: The selected time is processed to the minute.

techniqueSelector.targetShared: Target date (shared by progression + solar arc)

lunar.two: There are {n} lunar returns this month. To calculate the other one, change the order and recalculate (each return is 1 request; both remain as separate records).
lunar.name: Lunar return

techniqueSelector.lahiriFixed: Lahiri (fixed) — this calculation has no ayanamsa option.

panchanga.detail: Add detailed Panchanga (sunrise/sunset, vara, Rahu Kaal, Yamaganda, Gulika, Abhijit, Brahma muhurta) —
panchanga.hours: Add planetary hours (Hora, 24 slots) and Choghadiya (16 slots) —
panchanga.polar: This option is not calculated for places beyond the polar circle.

techniqueSelector.notLahiri: The selected ayanamsa is not Lahiri: this calculation is not made (the provider calculates only with Lahiri). Set the ayanamsa to Lahiri in the Vedic selections.

kp.nowHorary: Now (actual question moment · to the minute)
kp.placeIntro: The location where the question or event is considered —
kp.placeTail: . Techniques that need the birth chart use the saved birthplace separately.
kp.useBirth: Use the birthplace as the observation place
kp.placeRequired: This technique is not added to the plan until an observation place is selected.
kp.rulingNote: The ruling planets calculation takes no ayanamsa option (KP-Newcomb built in).
kp.momentNote: Single moment: the provider gives no transit analysis against natal cusps; this is the KP sky of the moment. For change times use “Time range”.

gochara.lahiri: Lahiri (fixed) — the Gochara calculation takes no ayanamsa option. It is a calculation and record separate from the Western transit.
gochara.notLahiri: The selected ayanamsa is not Lahiri: Gochara is not calculated (the provider calculates only with Lahiri).

chara.note: The scheme choice is a school preference; the two schemes are separate calculations and separate records.

techniqueSelector.relocation: Target location (the birth moment stays the same; only the location changes)

prof.wholeSign: The house system is fixed in this technique: Whole Sign. The house system preference in your birth chart analyses does not change.
prof.leap: 29 February birth: in non-leap years the new profection year starts on 1 March; in leap years on 29 February.

label.lilith: Black Moon Lilith — mean and true

extra.note: Hermetic lots require the birth time. The natal chart and natal request do not change; if a natal chart with the same house system is saved, the result is shown as a layer on the natal wheel.

pr.note: The return closest to this date is calculated. In a retrograde cycle the planet may cross its natal degree more than once; select the crossing below.
pr.navTitle: The target date becomes {d}; crossings are listed again
pr.navNone: Waiting for plan information or no return in this direction
pr.loop: This return cluster has {n} crossings (retrograde cycle). Each crossing is a separate request and a separate record; change the selection to calculate another one.
pr.none: No return found near the target date.
pr.name: Planetary return

fs.note: The orb is only a filter: data is fetched once from the provider with 3°; changing the orb creates no new request.
fs.catalog: Add the 43-star catalogue appendix to the Word/PDF report

hel.note: Visibility is assessed at the sunrise / sunset horizon and for the observation place; the birth time is not needed. Not calculated for places beyond ±60° latitude. This is a different calculation from the “combust” mark in the birth chart.

gm.roles: Calculation roles (in the traditional table role 1 is male / groom, role 2 female / bride):
gm.note: The other-person selection is shared with Synastry / Composite; both people's birth times are required. If the roles change, order-sensitive kootas (e.g. Varna) may score differently; each role order is a separate calculation and a separate record. The result is a technical assessment; it contains no marriage / relationship judgement.

role.clientFirst: Role 1: the analysed client · role 2: the other person
role.partnerFirst: Role 1: the other person · role 2: the analysed client

sadeSati.note: The status is given for the day of calculation (the assessment day is written to the record). Reopening on the same day creates no new request.

dk.roles: Calculation roles — role 1 (traditional: groom) / role 2 (traditional: bride):
dk.noteDashakoot: It is a system separate from Gun Milan; scores are not converted between them. Dina, Mahendra, Stree Deergha, Rasi and Vasya are counted from bride to groom and are therefore sensitive to role order; each role order is a separate calculation and a separate record.
dk.notePapasamyam: The comparison is directional (the role 2 total is compared with role 1's); each role order is a separate calculation and a separate record.
dk.note: The other-person selection is shared with the other two-person techniques; both people's birth times are required. The result is a technical assessment; it contains no marriage / relationship decision.

natal.note: Houses are calculated with the selected classical system; planetary positions do not change. Planet interpretations are not shown in this system.
natal.polar: The {hs} house system is undefined at latitude {lat}. Choose Whole Sign or Equal House.
natal.high: At this latitude house sizes can be very unequal; keep this in mind when interpreting.
natal.tu: Houses, Ascendant/MC and house placements are not shown; the selected house system is not used in this analysis.
natal.shared: {list} are calculated with the shared house system:
